feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 16 November 2026 10:30pm
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Monday, 16 November 2026 at 10:30pm by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Gales/ severe gales for a time.


##Synopsis##

Transient ridge of high pressure will continue to decline, as a deepening low in the Atlantic drives frontal systems into the area tonight.


##Wind##

East or Southeast 7 or gale 8, increasing occasionally severe gale 9 overnight. Decreasing 6 or 7 tomorrow morning, then gradually veering West 5 or 6 later in morning or afternoon, then Cyclonic 3 or 4 in evening.


##State of Sea##

Moderate or rough, perhaps touching very rough in the west overnight, becoming mainly moderate tomorrow morning, slight or moderate by evening.


##Weather##

Rain, turning patchy later.


##Visibility##

Moderate or good, occasionally poor in rain.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

Mainly Cyclonic 3 or 4, possibly East or Southeast 5 in north of area.


##State of Sea##

Slight or moderate.


##Weather##

Patchy rain.


##Visibility##

Good, falling moderate in rain.
